tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Work cards.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Figure areas, the mesh strip and proof cells.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: The light backing behind a real, published figure image, in both themes, so a figure drawn for white paper keeps its colours on a dark page.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, paragraphs and figure axes. Reads on ground, panel, inset and accent-tint.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Paragraph text inside cards, on panel.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: The lede under the headline, on ground. Figure labels, on inset.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Monospace labels and metadata, on ground, panel and inset.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: The heavy rules: under the header, the edges of the mesh strip, above the proof row. Full ink on light. A mid-grey on dark, about 4.6:1 on ground, because near-white rules glare there.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline borders around cards and cells. The faintest series in a figure. Decorative: below 3:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: The divider above a card's metadata line.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Grid-paper lines behind figures, on inset.

tokens.name: mesh
tokens.usage: Mesh-strip lines and secondary series in figures, on inset.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand colour, a petrol teal: accent bar, monogram fill, mesh interface line, callout marker, one highlighted series per figure, and link text. At least 4.6:1 on ground, panel and inset in light, and 7.8:1 in dark. The dark value is lighter so it holds on a dark page.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the highlighted box in a schematic. Carries ink text, never accent text: accent on this tint is only 4.4:1 in light.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill, such as the monogram letters. White on light at 5.1:1; near-black on dark at 8.5:1.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link text on ground, panel and inset. The same colour as accent in both themes.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link text on hover: darker on light, lighter on dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, solid, on every ground.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: From equations on paper to production code.
styles.usage: The page headline. Regular weight only. Fluid: size it with display-size, 34px on a phone.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: That loop has delivered 10 to 100-fold gains.
styles.usage: One emphasised sentence in a section. Fluid: callout-size.

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: A 1D model for a chaotic 3D flow
styles.usage: Work card titles. No trailing full stop.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I build simulation software for nonlinear, multi-scale systems.
styles.usage: The sentence under the headline, in ink-soft. Fluid: lede-size.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: I start from the physics and write the model down on paper.
styles.usage: Paragraphs in text sections, within measure.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Default text size for the page.
styles.usage: Base size on the page root.

styles.name: card-body
styles.sample: A model that treats nanometer-scale pores analytically.
styles.usage: Paragraph text in work cards, in ink-body.

styles.name: footer-link
styles.usage: Contact and profile links in the footer, in link.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels in ink-muted, the number in ink. Uppercase by CSS.

styles.name: monogram
styles.usage: The letters in the monogram, in on-accent.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The reference or date line at the foot of a card. Uppercase by CSS.

styles.name: figure-title
styles.usage: Box titles inside schematics, sized for a 320-unit-wide figure. Uppercase by CSS.

styles.name: figure-label
styles.usage: Axis labels and legends inside figures only, in ink-soft, sized for a 320-unit-wide figure.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between monogram and name. Gap between a card's title, text and metadata.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between paragraphs. Padding in proof cells. Pitch of the figure grid.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card padding. Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Headline to lede.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Accent bar to headline.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Gap between a section's rail label and its body.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner on the site is square.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Card, cell and figure borders in rule. Mesh-strip edges in rule-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The rule under the header and above the proof row, in rule-strong. The focus outline and its offset.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the content column.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of section paragraphs.

tokens.name: measure-lede
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the lede.

tokens.name: measure-display
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the headline, which holds it to two lines on desktop.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Width of the label column beside a text section.

tokens.name: card-min
tokens.usage: Minimum card width before the card grid drops a column.

tokens.name: cell-min
tokens.usage: Minimum proof-cell width before the row wraps.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any link or control.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Side of the monogram square.

tokens.name: mesh-height

tokens.name: accent-bar-width
tokens.usage: Width of the accent bar above the headline.

tokens.name: accent-bar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the accent bar above the headline.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of the content column: 20px on a phone, 40px on desktop.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Space above each section.

tokens.name: hero-top

tokens.name: hero-bottom

tokens.name: lede-size
